lead: AI continues to influence various sectors, from music to application security, raising questions about its implications and future.

stories.title: Is the most popular song played on Australian radio stations the product of generative AI?
stories.summary: Josh Fawaz’s cover of Madonna’s 'Like a Prayer' has sparked debate over the use of generative AI in music production. The song's rapid rise to popularity has led some experts to question whether it was created by human effort or AI assistance. This controversy highlights the complexities and ethical considerations surrounding AI's role in creative industries.

stories.title: Christopher Nolan says people ‘disdain’ AI and the idea it will replace humans is ‘nonsense’
stories.summary: Renowned director Christopher Nolan has defended the role of human creativity in filmmaking amidst rising concerns about AI's impact on the industry. He argues that while AI can assist, it cannot replace the unique vision and artistry of human filmmakers. Nolan’s remarks come as he promotes his latest film, 'The Odyssey'.

stories.title: AI is accelerating software development, creating new challenges for application security
stories.summary: The integration of AI in software development is transforming application security, presenting both opportunities and challenges. As AI tools streamline coding processes, they also introduce new vulnerabilities that security teams must address. This evolving landscape necessitates a proactive approach to safeguarding applications against AI-related threats.

stories.title: How Monash University is tackling the AI-driven app security gap
stories.summary: Monash University is taking steps to address the security gaps that arise from AI's influence on application development. By focusing on human connection and collaboration, the university aims to enhance security measures in an increasingly AI-driven environment. This initiative underscores the importance of integrating human oversight in technological advancements.

stories.title: AI has triggered the biggest gas-plant building boom in history, and a quiet fight to stop it
stories.summary: The AI boom has inadvertently led to a surge in the construction of natural gas power plants, raising environmental concerns. This unprecedented building spree is driven by the energy demands of AI data centers, prompting activists and communities to push back against the expansion. The situation highlights the complex relationship between technological advancement and environmental sustainability.

stories.title: Most Americans now say the public should own half of the big AI companies
stories.summary: A recent survey reveals that nearly 70% of Americans support the idea of transferring half the stock of major AI companies to a public sovereign wealth fund. This shift in public opinion reflects growing concerns about the concentration of power within the AI sector and the need for broader accountability and ownership.

stories.title: Darren Aronofsky's '1776' AI Video Series Is Unhinged, and I Can't Look Away
stories.summary: Darren Aronofsky's latest project, an AI-driven video series titled 'On This Day...1776', explores historical events through a modern lens. The series showcases the potential of generative AI in storytelling, while also raising questions about the implications of using AI in creative narratives. Critics have noted its unique and often bizarre approach to historical storytelling.

stories.title: The fight against AI data centers is just beginning
stories.summary: Communities are increasingly opposing the construction of AI data centers due to their environmental impact and energy consumption. The article discusses the historical context of these protests and the growing awareness of the consequences of AI infrastructure on local ecosystems and power grids. Activists are mobilizing to challenge the expansion of these facilities.
